description: Functions a screen translator may call. Each maps to a Sentinal protocol Event; entries marked proposed are not in the protocol yet.

functions.name: progress_updated
functions.description: The latest visible progress of one kind (at most one call per unit).

total.description: Total steps if printed, else null.

unit.description: epoch, step, %, test, file, or the printed size unit (MB, GB, objects).

functions.name: metric_reported
functions.description: The latest visible value of one named training or throughput metric.

name.description: Metric name, e.g. loss, val_loss, learning_rate, accuracy, perplexity, reward, tokens_per_second.

functions.name: checkpoint_created
functions.description: A checkpoint or model file was written (not loaded).

functions.name: error_detected
functions.description: One distinct error visible on screen. Never copy secrets into the summary.

functions.name: warning_detected
functions.description: One warning line visible on screen.

functions.name: waiting_for_input
functions.description: The last screen line is a prompt that is waiting for the user.

functions.name: server_started
functions.description: The running program started listening. URL without query strings or tokens.

functions.name: tests_summary
functions.description: Final pass/fail/skip counts of a test run.

functions.name: propose_recipe
functions.description: Recipes suite only: a reusable Recipe for a command run repeatedly with varying values.

template.description: The command with {param} placeholders where values varied.
